brief: Postwar minimal traditional house of about 1946: one storey, side-gabled with a small front-gable entry bay, white siding, a picture window and a short drive to a detached garage on a bare new lot.

facade.notes: (Middletown OH appraisal snapshot, scalloped-edge print): a 1946 one-storey postwar house, gable end toward the street with a louvred vent, a side entry under a small hood, a TV antenna; a matching house next door; a detached block garage behind; foundation shrubs

why.note: veterans' housing 1946: the same small plan repeated down the street
